questions.question: How many orders have a total payment that differs from the sum of their items' price plus freight by more than 1 BRL?

WITH item_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS item_total
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
pay_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS pay_total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)

FROM item_totals i
JOIN pay_totals p USING (order_id)
WHERE abs(p.pay_total - i.item_total) > 1

  SELECT extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         sum(p.payment_value) AS revenue

             / sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE yr = 2017), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM period_revenue
